customer_question: We searched for our company (Ito-en) in the SIG Member Directory and could not find it. Can we proceed with Bluetooth certification?
question_variants: Our company is not in the SIG Member Directory — what does that mean for certification?
Is SIG membership required before Bluetooth certification?
actual_issue: Ito-en is not listed in the SIG Member Directory, which means the company has not registered as a SIG member. SIG membership (at minimum Associate or Adopter level) is a prerequisite for Bluetooth certification. Without membership, neither a Qualification Workspace nor a QDID/DID can be created. The customer must first register as a SIG member before any certification work can proceed.
plain_english_explanation: The Bluetooth SIG requires all companies that want to certify Bluetooth products to first be registered members of the SIG. There are different membership tiers — the minimum needed for certification is Adopter Member. If a company does not appear in the SIG Member Directory, they are not yet a member and cannot proceed with certification until they join. This is a separate prerequisite from the Qualification Fee.
consultant_answer: Ito-en is not in the SIG Member Directory, meaning they are not yet a SIG member. They must register as an Associate or Adopter Member before any Bluetooth certification can begin.
decision_logic:
1. Search the customer's company name in the SIG Member Directory (https://www.bluetooth.com/develop-with-bluetooth/join-the-sig/).
2. If not found → customer is not a SIG member → must register before certification can proceed.
3. Minimum membership for certification: Adopter Member (or higher).
4. Notify the customer and provide SIG membership registration instructions.
final_recommendation: Always check SIG membership status at project intake. If the customer is not found in the Member Directory, halt the certification process and direct them to register as a SIG member first before any other steps.
risk_if_done_wrong: If certification work starts before the customer is a SIG member, the Qualification Workspace cannot be created under their account, and all preparation work must be redone or transferred after membership is established.
search_aliases: company not in SIG Member Directory
must join SIG before Bluetooth certification
